result.summary: Removes an upper-bound duration assertion in `interface_http.py` when testing HTTP server idle timeouts. The test retains the lower-bound check and the socket timeout expectation, leaving exact timeout verification to mock-clock unit tests.
result.problem: Testing that the HTTP server disconnects before an arbitrary upper bound (`seconds + 2`) triggers false-negative test failures in CI on slow runners.
evidence: Closes #36755, which reported the flaky CI failure on slow runners.
Description notes the timing upper bound "was helpful during development of #35182 but has led to false negatives in CI on platforms that are just plain slow."
result.changed_since_previous: Diff provided matches the previous description; no functional changes between descriptions.
result.card: This PR removes an arbitrary upper-bound duration check when testing HTTP client disconnects in interface_http.py. The assertion caused intermittent false negatives in CI on slow test platforms. Timeout regressions remain caught by the socket timeout and unit tests using mock clocks. Fixes #36755.

risk.why: A mistake would only affect functional test execution without impacting production node behavior.
